use: Change code in the project: the conductor's plan, its review, the coder's change, then code review and tests side by side. A small change skips the plan and its review.

steps.does: Write the plan, breaking the request into steps.
Review the plan with your plan-review skill before any code changes.
Change the code as the plan says, or as the request says when there is no plan.
Read and review the changed code with your code-review skill.
Run the project's tests on the changed code and try the changed screens yourself.
